title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:

Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering

Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

title: Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d)
description:
About ALVA Energie

At ALVA Energie, we’re driving the energy transition forward! With solar operator models for apartment buildings and commercial properties, we offer a comprehensive, worry-free package: from installation and management to the operation of PV systems as an energy supplier. Our goal is to make the decentralized energy transition simple and accessible. 🌞

As a growing startup in Berlin, we value teamwork, responsibility, and active participation. Everyone has the opportunity to actively contribute to our growth and share their ideas. Together, we’re working toward a sustainable future. 🚀

About your role

We think: impact over headcount! At our company, FP&A doesn't grow with the volume of work, but with its impact on the business. Data preparation, variance commentary and standard reports belong to automation and agents. Our people's time belongs to what machines can't do: judgment, model logic, challenge and decisions. If an additional hire enables significantly more impact, we grow. But never to absorb manual work that is better built than distributed.

You are the first dedicated hire in FP&A, start as an Individual Contributor and work directly with the CFO and management. Our existing models and tools have grown organically and are partly manual. You understand them, keep what works, rebuild the rest and automate consistently. With AI agents, you build the leverage that elsewhere would take an entire team.

Outlook: The path to Head of FP&A is open, but not planned for the short term. Your responsibility grows with the impact you create, not with team size.

Your responsibilities

As the Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d), you will drive financial planning, analysis, and artificial intelligence initiatives to support our growing operations.

  • Rebuild the FP&A foundation: current-state assessment, target architecture, budget, rolling forecast and multi-year planning

  • Build and maintain integrated, driver-based financial models (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) for projects, the portfolio and the group, including multi-entity planning and intercompany

  • Develop the KPI framework and prepare management, board, investor and bank reporting with clear recommendations for action

  • Run scenario and sensitivity analyses and conduct deep dives on investments, financing, pricing and portfolio prioritization

  • Build and operate agentic AI workflows for forecasting, anomaly detection, variance commentary and reporting, incl. guardrails and governance

  • Close collaboration with the Data Team: you bring the finance logic and are the most demanding user of the data

  • Evaluate and implement suitable FP&A tools and manage tool and AI costs (FinOps)

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of experience in FP&A, controlling or strategic finance, ideally in a high-growth, complex environment

  • Very good financial modeling skills (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and understanding of complex financial and intercompany structures

  • Experience in rebuilding or redesigning planning and reporting processes, as well as with planning and BI tools

  • Hands-on mentality and enjoyment in building structures yourself

  • Strong communication skills: you convince management, investors, banks and business functions

Ideally you bring:

  • Energy sector experience, ideally solar/renewables, or other project-based business models

  • Multi-entity planning, intercompany and investor/bank reporting

  • Good German language skills

  • Experience with Claude or other AI coding tools and agentic workflows

In addition, we value the following skills:

  • Tech affinity: You see new tools and AI as leverage, not as a threat

  • Openness to change: You approach change positively and with agility

  • Impact mindset: For every analysis, you ask which decision it enables, and for every task: "Does a human need to do this, and where does it create the greatest impact?"

  • Entrepreneurial thinking: You always consider financial decisions in the context of growth, market opportunities and overall strategy

  • Drive to shape: You look at an organically grown Excel model and know what to keep, what to rebuild and what an agent can take over

  • You are motivated by the mission to advance the energy transition

Here’s what you can expect from us:

With your ideas, you’ll have the chance to enrich our dynamic team and actively help shape the future of solar energy at a rapidly growing startup!

  • Flat hierarchies, quick decision-making, and direct communication in a relaxed and positive work environment

  • Creative freedom—with us, you’ll have 100% responsibility for what you do and will have the opportunity to grow through challenges

  • Close collaboration with the founders, leading to a steep learning curve

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home ensure a good work-life balance

  • A modern office in the heart of Berlin with excellent BVG transit connections (e.g., Nordbahnhof, Rosenthaler Platz)

  • A fully stocked kitchen with coffee, soft drinks, and snacks available around the clock

  • Regular team lunches and other team events

  • We offer attractive subsidies for Urban Sports Club, a JobRad bike, and public transportation

title: Member of Technical Staff Intern - Germany
description:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff Intern, you'll build the system that decides how some of the largest manufacturers in the world operate. That means combining agent-based reasoning with mathematical optimization and simulation on large-scale industrial data.

  • Build agents people trust – when an agent runs a factory's week, the largest industrial companies in the world have to trust it with their critical processes and understand every decision it makes; you build the routing, orchestration and guardrails behind that

  • Ship features end-to-end – you understand the user need, and you get the freedom to build it across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend and frontend, in production in your first weeks

  • Work close to the users – sit with the planners who use it, see what would make their work 10x faster, and build it

You'll own your own features from day one, and what you ship decides what a plant does next week.

​

YOU

  • Full-stack shipper – you've shipped production code end-to-end, you build scalable backend and infra that handles massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, and you build the interface that makes it usable

  • Highly technical – you've built something technically hard, and you can walk us through every decision behind it

  • Product sense – you spot the feature hiding in a user's complaint, and you've deleted your own favorite one because nobody used it

  • You care about getting it right – you know when it has to be 100% and when to keep it simple, and when it matters, you're still chasing the root cause at 2am

  • Sense of urgency – you'd rather ship it tonight than sleep on an open PR

  • Language – you're fully fluent in German and English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich (we support visa)

​

TECH STACK

  • FE (TypeScript): React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite

  • BE (Python): FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster

  • AI: Pydantic AI, Langfuse

title: Senior Backend Engineer – Platform & Reliability
description:
About Maesn

Want to join a growing European startup early and be part of an epic journey?

At Maesn we build software for other software companies. We provide an integration platform that lets B2B software companies add integrations to their platforms in hours and days instead of weeks and months. Our customers love us because we are innovative, quick, friendly and provide integrations for systems that others dare not touch.

We are a young dynamic SaaS Startup born in Düsseldorf who believe in working hard and having fun while doing it. You will have the chance to work on all parts of our technology stack and in close collaboration with our customers, to understand their needs and get direct feedback on the changes you ship.

The role

Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. You’ll work directly with our CTO, Lennart Svensson, and the wider founder team.

What you will do

Own our Azure infrastructure end-to-end

You know every service, how it’s deployed and what it costs. You’ll tighten what’s there and codify what isn’t. As we scale, you’ll keep the architecture simple: we run on managed services and plan to keep it that way.

Bring real observability to the platform

Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. You’ll define what “healthy” means, build the dashboards, and set up alerting and on-call so we catch problems before our clients do. When a mysterious timeout appears, you’re the one who can trace it to its source.

Raise the bar on security and reliability

Fintechs trust us with sensitive financial data. You’ll harden the platform, make sure we can deliver on incident response and SLAs, and keep us audit-ready as customers ask for certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

Build product and level up the team

You’ll ship features and integrations with the rest of the engineering team. You’ll also be the go-to person for production debugging, and you’ll mentor our engineers so the whole team gets better at running what we build.

What you bring

  • Experience: 5+ years building and running backend services in production, including real ownership of infrastructure, deployments and incidents.

  • Production debugging: You’ve chased down latency spikes, timeouts and flaky dependencies, and you know how to go from “something is slow” to the root cause.

  • Azure: Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on Azure.

  • Observability: Experience instrumenting services with tracing, structured logging and metrics, ideally with OpenTelemetry or similar.

  • Infrastructure-as-code mindset: You codify infrastructure rather than clicking through consoles.

  • Security by default: You think about secrets, access management, and compliance as part of the work, not as an afterthought.

  • Backend skills: You’re comfortable writing production code in TypeScript/Node.js and enjoy shipping features, not only keeping the lights on.

  • Pragmatism and mentoring: You pick the simplest setup that works. You enjoy helping less experienced engineers grow, and you’re excited to set the standards for how we run our platform.

What we offer

  • First-hand experience building a fast-growing tech startup

  • Kind teammates and great collaborative atmosphere

  • Steep learning curve and a varied job with interesting projects and technologies

  • Work fully remote or in our office in Düsseldorf

  • Fun offsites where the team gets together to work and play

  • One-time allowance for improving your home office

  • Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership

  • Laptop and work equipment

  • 30 days of PTO + Local holidays

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Want to work on Software-Defined Defense? 

At Apex.AI, we develop safety-certified software for mobility systems and intelligent machines. Our products power applications in automotive, trucking, robotics, aerospace, agriculture, industrial automation, and defense systems.

We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to design and scale Apex.AI's build and release systems. You will architect and implement our build and release system solutions, which impact developer productivity company-wide and ensure that customers receive high-quality products in a timely manner.

In this role, you will work directly with European defense customers and internal product teams to design, build, deploy, and Apex.Alan. You will help customers bring real-world systems to production while contributing improvements and features back into our core platform. Find out more about Apex.Alan here and here.

This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany and German language skills are required.


What You Bring
  • B.S. or higher degree in a technical field with 5+ years of relevant work experience 
  • Proven experience working with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Proven experience maintaining a cross-platform build system 
  • Proven experience managing CI/CD pipelines 
  • Proven ability to script in Python and Starlark 
  • Proven experience building C/C++ projects with Bazel
  • Familiarity with GitLab or GitHub 
  • Experience navigating Linux-based systems and tools in a terminal
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills  
  • Excellent communication skills 
  • German language skills

    • Nice To Have
  • Experience with infrastructure management tools such as Terraform 
  • Experience with Bazel internals 
  • Familiarity with releasing code and binaries to customers 
  • Familiarity with cross-compilation 
  • Experience with the usage of CMake 
  • Experience developing Bazel infrastructure 

    • Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

Als Embedded Software Entwickler übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung der Flugsteuerungs- und Bedienersoftware unserer Drohnensysteme. 

  • Flight Control: Technische Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung der Flugsteuerungssoftware und deren zuverlässigen Betrieb auf der Zielhardware. 

  • Bodenkontrollsoftware: Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Bedienersoftware auf Basis von Qt und QML für Missionsplanung, Drohnenüberwachung und Nutzlaststeuerung.

  • Hardwareintegration: Anbindung und Integration von Sensoren, Funkmodulen, Kameras, Ladesystemen und weiteren Nutzlasten.

  • Architektur: Mitarbeit an technischen Architekturentscheidungen in enger Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung.

Dein Profil als Embedded Software Entwickler

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, davon überwiegend im Embedded Bereich oder in der hardwarenahen C und C++ Entwicklung. 

  • Sehr gute praktische Kenntnisse in modernem C++, Qt und QML. Sowie Linux und Git. 

  • Erfahrung darin, sich selbstständig in umfangreiche bestehende Codebasen einzuarbeiten und komplexe Softwarestrukturen schnell zu verstehen. 

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im hardwarenahen Debugging, insbesondere mit Sensoren, Schnittstellen wie UART, CAN, SPI oder I2C sowie der Analyse von Logs und Fehlerbildern auf Zielhardware.

Du unterstützt bei der Abwicklung und Koordination von Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsaktivitäten.

Nach dem Traineeprogramm sollst du deinen ersten kleinen Bereich übernehmen, dabei wirst du zum Ansprechpartner für Kollegen aus anderen Fachabteilungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmarketing bei der Steuerung von Produktkampagnen zusammen.

Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per ‚Du‘. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.

Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.

Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren.

Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und möchtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können?

Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.

Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.

Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.

Excel oder sogar Pivot sind für dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse könntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern überzeugen.

title: (Senior) Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
description:
Ein erster Einblick:

Wir, die MIFCOM GmbH, bieten die besten Jobs in der Gaming-Branche. Als einer der führenden Hersteller persönlich konfigurierbarer PCs und Notebooks für Gamer und anspruchsvolle Nutzer sind wir immer auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten, mit einem Faible für Technik, die gemeinsam mit uns ihren nächsten Karriereschritt machen wollen.

Mit über 180 engagierten Mitarbeitern fertigen wir an 2 Standorten PCs, Workstations und Server nach Kundenwunsch. Egal ob Business-Laptop oder High-End Gaming PC, wir setzen alles daran die Vorstellungen unserer Kunden umzusetzen – „Geht nicht, gibt’s nicht!“

Dabei sind ein Höchstmaß an Flexibilität, bedingungslose Kundenorientierung und eine ausgesprochene Hands-On Mentalität die Grundpfeiler unserer täglichen Arbeit. Vielfach von der Fachpresse ausgezeichnet und mit besten Kundenbewertungen sind wir der führende PC-Systembuilder in Deutschland.

Wir sind aktuell auf der Suche nach einem (Senior) Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d), der unsere Finanzabteilung mit fundierter Expertise im Hauptbuch und in sämtlichen Umsatzsteuerthemen verstärkt.


Deine Aufgaben:

Als (Senior) Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) bist Du Teil unserer Finanzabteilung und arbeitest eng mit Deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie unserem CFO zusammen. Als erfahrener Profi in Sachen Finanzbuchhaltung übernimmst Du Verantwortung für zentrale Themen in unserem Team – mit einem klaren Fokus auf das Hauptbuch und die Umsatzsteuer.

Deine täglichen To-Dos umfassen vor allem die folgenden Tätigkeiten:

  • Du betreust das Hauptbuch inklusive der Abstimmung sämtlicher Sachkonten und der Anlagenbuchhaltung
  • Du bereitest die Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB vor und erstellst und verbuchst Rückstellungen und Abgrenzungen
  • Du behältst die Liquiditätssteuerung des Unternehmens im Auge gemeinsam mit unserem CFO und der Teamleitung Finance, das betrifft Zahlläufe, Cash-Prognosen und ggf. auch Bankenkommunikation
  • Du erstellst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen, zusammenfassende Meldungen und die Umsatzsteuerjahreserklärung in Abstimmung mit unserer Steuerkanzlei und stimmst diese ab
  • Du prüfst und beurteilst umsatzsteuerliche Sachverhalte, z.B. innergemeinschaftliche Lieferungen, Ausfuhren, Reihengeschäfte sowie Fernverkäufe über das OSS-Verfahren
  • Du begleitest die Umsetzung der E-Rechnungspflicht und stellst die umsatzsteuerliche Compliance in unseren Prozessen und Systemen sicher
  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer und Finanzbehörden, u.a. bei Umsatzsteuer-Sonderprüfungen und Betriebsprüfungen
  • Du unterstützt bei Engpässen unsere Kreditoren-/Debitorenbuchhaltung und übernimmst die laufenden Buchungen im Tagesgeschäft
  • Du erstellst Reportings und Statistiken für Deine Stakeholder im Management
  • Zusätzlich treibst Du die Einführung neuer und die Verbesserung unserer aktuellen Prozesse aktiv voran bspw. die Einbindung von KI-Tools in die Finanzbuchhaltung


Dein Profil:

Bei MIFCOM hören wir nie auf zu lernen und uns weiterzuentwickeln. Wir glauben daran, dass eine perfekte Mischung aus technischem Fachwissen und Soft-Skills einen guten Kandidaten auszeichnen. Unser Anforderungsprofil ist eine erste Richtlinie, aber wir sind immer auf der Suche nach neuen Mitarbeitern, die ihre eigene Perspektive und den Willen, etwas zu bewegen mitbringen.

Als unser idealer Kandidat bringst Du folgende Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen mit:

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Steuerfachangestellten / Steuerfachgehilfen (m/w/d) oder eine Qualifikation zum Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) – idealerweise hast Du zusätzlich die Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) abgeschlossen
  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, bestenfalls hast Du einen Teil davon in einer Steuerkanzlei gesammelt
  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in der Hauptbuchhaltung sowie in der Vorbereitung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen mit
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umsatzsteuerrecht – nationale wie grenzüberschreitende Sachverhalte sind für Dich kein Neuland
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit Tools wie Datev und Excel und KI-Tools wie Claude
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und sorgfältig, gehst Dinge proaktiv an und bringst Dich aktiv in die Verbesserung und Einführung von Prozessen ein
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab


Warum MIFCOM?

Performance steht bei allem, was wir tun, im Mittelpunkt. Unsere Produkte erfüllen die höchsten Anforderungen unserer Kunden; der Name MIFCOM steht für Zuverlässigkeit, Präzision und ein Maximum an Leistung.

Bei uns erwartet Dich ein spannendes und dynamisches Umfeld mit einer Vielfalt an verschiedenen Aufgaben und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, sowie ein umfassendes Benefits Paket, das Dir unter anderem folgendes bietet:

  • Ein spannender, anspruchsvoller und abwechslungsreicher Job in einem engagierten Team mit einer "Du"-Kultur und familiärer Atmosphäre
  • Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit attraktiver Vergütung, sowie flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und all das beim führenden PC-Systemintegrator
  • Eine Home-Office-Möglichkeit und individuelle Gestaltung des Arbeitsplatzes sowie technischer Ausstattung (PC, Monitore, Peripherie, etc.)
  • Viel Freiraum und Möglichkeiten, Deine Ideen einzubringen und umzusetzen
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungen, je nach persönlichen Interessen & Schwerpunkten samt zahlreichen Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen
  • Arbeit mit neuester Computerhardware und neuesten Technologien - mache Dein Hobby zum Beruf
  • Kostenfreier Kaffee & Getränke sowie fußläufig gut erreichbare Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Foodtrucks und Restaurants
  • Nach der Probezeit: z.B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad, attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen, uvm.
  • Sonstige Benefits, wie z.B. 30 Tage Urlaub, Fitness-Abo (EGYM Wellpass), Corporate Benefits, etc.
  • Eine große Dachterrasse für ein gemütliches Miteinander, Firmenevents, regelmäßige Grillpartys, Tischtennis, uvm.
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
Du hast es bis hierher geschafft, was nur eines bedeuten kann – Du bist zu 100% bereit, den nächsten Schritt zu machen, um Teil unseres fantastischen Teams zu werden.

Wir bei MIFCOM leben unsere Core Values jeden Tag. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und das spiegelt sich auch in unserem Handeln, Mindset und dem Umgang mit Kollegen und Kunden wider.

Wir sind stolz darauf, was wir bisher erreicht haben und freuen uns auf Dich als neuestes Mitglied unseres fantastischen Teams.

Bist Du bereit, das neueste Mitglied unseres Finanzteams zu werden? 
Dann bewirb Dich jetzt!

title: Data Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

We have challenging tasks for you:

As a Data Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for building and evolving modern cloud platforms for Data & AI. Together with our team and our clients, you will develop platforms that can be operated in a scalable, secure, and sustainable manner.

In doing so, you will combine cloud infrastructure, platform architecture, and modern Data & AI technologies into solutions that create a stable foundation for analytics, data engineering, and AI use cases.

In detail, you will:

  • Design, build, and continuously evolve cloud-based Data & AI platforms

  • Develop platform strategies and target architectures together with our clients and implement them technically

  • Design scalable and robust platform architectures that serve as a foundation for data-driven solutions

  • Provision modern cloud infrastructures on Azure or AWS automatically using Infrastructure as Code

  • Work specifically with Terraform or OpenTofu as well as modern CI/CD processes

  • Design and evolve Databricks platforms regarding workspaces, compute, networking, identity, security, and governance

  • Make architecture decisions and establish best practices for performance, security, governance, scalability, and cost optimization

  • Develop reusable platform blueprints, standards, and automations

  • Evaluate new technologies and platform components and integrate them meaningfully into existing architectures

  • Support data, analytics, and AI teams by providing stable and high-performance platforms

  • Contribute to technical concepts, architecture workshops, and the further development of our standards together with our team


Your profile

What we are looking for

You work in a structured manner, think in terms of platforms and architectures, and implement technical solutions cleanly and sustainably.

Ideally, you bring to the table:

  • Sound experience in building modern cloud infrastructures and platform architectures

  • Excellent knowledge of at least one cloud platform, ideally Microsoft Azure or AWS

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or comparable technologies

  • A strong understanding of scalable, secure, and maintainable system and platform architectures

  • Experience with technologies in the Data & AI domain, particularly Databricks

  • Knowledge in areas such as cloud networking, identity & access management, security, and governance

  • Basic software development skills, e.g., with Python, as well as experience handling APIs and automation

  • Experience with Git and CI/CD

  • A solid understanding of the requirements that data, analytics, ML, and AI workloads place on a modern platform

  • A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification

  • The ability to quickly learn new technologies and apply them purposefully

  • A structured, self-reliant, and solution-oriented way of working

  • Very good German skills (C2) and good English skills

What we would also be happy to see:

  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog and governance concepts

  • Experience with Azure Private Link, VNet Integration, or comparable AWS networking concepts

  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD solutions

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or other data platform technologies

  • Experience with Landing Zones, platform blueprints, or standardized cloud deployments

  • Experience in client projects and technical architecture workshops

  • Certifications in the context of Databricks, Azure, or AWS


Why us?

Are you looking to design and build modern Data & AI platforms in the cloud and actively shape the technical future for our clients?

Do you think in terms of platforms and architectures, enjoy working hands-on with Infrastructure as Code, and want to create sustainable foundations for data and AI applications?

What awaits you with us: High-end tech & genuine appreciation:

  • Modern Platform Engineering: You will design and automate scalable cloud Data & AI platforms on Azure or AWS. We rely on clean code (e.g., with Terraform/OpenTofu), CI/CD, and reusable platform blueprints—no quick-and-dirty hacks.

  • Databricks & Governance Excellence: Whether it's Unity Catalog, workspaces, cloud networking (such as Private Link), or Identity & Access Management—you will design secure, high-performance Databricks environments based on top best practices.

  • Steep Learning Curve toward Core Expertise: We actively support your growth from specialist to trusted advisor. Further certifications (e.g., Databricks, Azure, AWS) are fully covered by us!

  • Creative Freedom & Client Contact: You will develop target architectures, facilitate architecture workshops, and advise clients on equal footing during the implementation of their Data & AI strategies.

  • Best-in-Class Setup: Work with state-of-the-art cloud technologies, cutting-edge tools, and premium equipment.

  • Genuine Team Culture: International exchange, mutual support, and flat hierarchies. We collaborate on technical concepts and enjoy celebrating success together.

  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: We embrace flexible working models—depending on the team and department, our colleagues work hybrid or remote-only. For this role, a hybrid model with 2 fixed work-from-home days per week is preferred to achieve the ideal balance of focus time and personal interaction. In the case of an absolute perfect match, we are naturally open to a full-remote option.

title: Working Student International Energy Advisory (m/w/d)
description:
Westbridge-Gruppe | Was uns antreibt

Gebäude müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es Transparenz, messbare Daten und intelligente Lösungen. 

Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der ersten strategischen Idee über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. 

Um diesen Weg weiterzugehen und gemeinsam mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden die Energieversorgung von morgen zu gestalten, suchen wir dich als Working Student im Projektmanagement (m/w/d) für unser Team Energy International in Frankfurt am Main.


Deine Aufgaben

In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung und arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team an Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

  • Du unterstützt das Projektmanagement International bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer Konzepte zur Kostenoptimierung sowie Effizienzsteigerung im Energieverbrauch.
  • Im Rahmen deiner Tätigkeit wirkst Du bei der Analyse, Aufbereitung und Auswertung projektrelevanter Daten mit und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Entscheidungsfindung.
  • Du unterstützt das Team im operativen Projektmanagement-Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst dabei organisatorische und koordinative Aufgaben.
  • Zudem begleitest du Ausschreibungsprozesse sowie Bietergespräche und unterstützt bei der Kommunikation mit externen Partnern, insbesondere internationale Energieversorgern.
  • Die Vorbereitung und Strukturierung von Vertragsunterlagen für Verhandlungen gehört ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich.
  • Darüber hinaus erstellst du Präsentationen zur Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und wirkst bei der Aufbereitung von Ergebnissen für interne und externe Stakeholder mit.


Das bringst du mit

Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium an einer Fach- oder Hochschule – vorzugsweise in den Bereichen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Energiewirtschaft oder BWL.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Projektmanagement oder in der Energie- bzw. Immobilienwirtschaft gesammelt.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch lösungsorientiertes, analytisches und strukturiertes Denken und Handeln aus.
  • Teamfähigkeit und Einsatzbereitschaft gehören ebenso zu deinen Stärken wie ein professionelles und sicheres Auftreten.
  • Du verfügst über gute Grundkenntnisse in MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere in Excel.


So arbeiten wir

Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Fachrichtungen zusammen und erhältst Einblicke in spannende Projekte und Themen rund um die Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberatung. Dabei kannst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium einbringen, praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln. 

Damit dies gelingt, bieten wir dir die entsprechenden Rahmenbedingungen: Wir bieten dir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem du dich gut einfinden und konzentriert arbeiten kannst – mit moderner Ausstattung, guter Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr sowie Getränken, Snacks und frischem Obst.

Dein nächster Schritt

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mit dir darüber zu sprechen, wie dein nächster beruflicher Schritt aussehen soll – und ob wir der richtige Partner dafür sind.

  • M&A & PMI: Du unterstützt bei M&A-bezogenen Finance-Fragestellungen und erhältst Einblicke in Transaktionen und Due-Diligence-Prozesse.   • Accounting: Du unterstützt unser Accounting-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und lernst dabei die zentralen Prozesse der Finanzbuchhaltung aus erster Hand kennen. Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen mit und entwickelst so ein fundiertes Verständnis dafür, wie Accounting und Reporting in der Praxis zusammenspielen.
  • Strategische Finance-Projekte: Du arbeitest an bereichsübergreifenden Finance-Projekten und aktuellen Fragestellungen mit und übernimmst dabei eigene Teilaufgaben. Das bringst du mit

Dabei kannst du dein Wissen aus dem Studium unmittelbar in der Praxis anwenden und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickeln. Uns ist wichtig, dass du nicht nur zuschaust, sondern von Beginn an aktiv mitarbeitest und einen echten Beitrag zu unserem Finance-Team leistest. 

Was uns besonders auszeichnet, ist unser Team: Wir sind ein junges, ambitioniertes Finance-Team mit hoher Dynamik, kurzen Abstimmungswegen und einem starken Zusammenhalt. Wir suchen jemanden wie Dich: Du übernimmst die Stelle als People Operations Specialist und verantwortest diesen Bereich bei uns eigenständig – wir haben keine separate HR-Abteilung, sondern People Operations ist als stand-alone Funktion in unserem Company Resources-Team verankert und direkt mit dem Management verzahnt. Das heißt für Dich: viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Chance, Deinen Bereich zu gestalten.

Aufgaben

Die Rolle: People Operations Specialist (m/w/d)

  • Arbeitszeit: 80–100 % (32-40h) – flexibel und in Absprache mit Dir
  • Ort: 100 % Remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für die EU ist Voraussetzung.
  • Team: Du verantwortest People Operations eigenständig – als Teil unseres Company Resources-Teams und in engem, direktem Austausch mit dem Management.

Deine Mission: Hier übernimmst Du Verantwortung!

Als alleinige Verantwortliche*r für People Operations sorgst Du für reibungslose und korrekte Abläufe. Wenn Du Freude daran hast, Strukturen zu pflegen, Prozesse zu optimieren und eine zuverlässige Unterstützung für das Team zu sein, dann ist das Deine Chance:

  • Payroll-Vorbereitung und -Kontrolle: Du bereitest die monatliche Gehaltsabrechnung für Deutschland und Belgien vor und kontrollierst sie; Österreich und die Schweiz betreust Du anlassbezogen – Genauigkeit und Termintreue sind entscheidend.

Die Behördenkorrespondenz koordinierst Du mit unseren externen Berater*innen.

  • Kennzahlen, Berichtspflichten und Datenschutz: Du lieferst Personalkennzahlen für Management und Förderprojekte und verantwortest den Datenschutz im Personalbereich sowie die Datengrundlage für die EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie.

  • Recruiting-Operations: Du koordinierst das Bewerber*innen-Management inkl. Terminplanung und Rückmeldungen – Auswahl und Gespräche liegen bei den Hiring Manager*innen.

Qualifikation

Passt Du zu uns?

  • HRIS-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits mit einem modernen HRIS gearbeitet – aus der Administration, nicht nur aus der Nutzersicht (z. B. Personio, HiBob, BambooHR, Leapsome). Leapsome-Erfahrung ist ein klares Plus, da wir es aktuell zur führenden Datenquelle für unsere Personaldaten ausbauen; Erfahrung mit Join ist ein weiteres Plus.
  • Teamplayer*in im Remote-Setup: Du arbeitest gerne remote und schätzt den engen Austausch mit dem Company Resources Team und dem Management.
  • Klare Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung – Du kommunizierst verständlich mit Kolleg*innen auf allen Ebenen, im In- und Ausland.

Benefits

  • Sinn & Impact: Du arbeitest in einem Unternehmen, dessen Kerngeschäft Klimaschutz ist – und hältst dabei die Strukturen zusammen, ohne die niemand von uns arbeiten könnte.

description:
About Smartnumbers

We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. 
 
We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. 
 
We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys. Together, we protect some of the UKs largest banks, insurance companies and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people into high performing teams.


What you'll be working on

We're looking for someone to build out a long term 2–3 year strategic pipeline. As part of the role, you will be expected to do the following: 
 

  • Build and maintain a 12–18 month active pipeline to support business objectives
  • Build and maintain relevant market awareness through client discussions, market research and industry events
  • Provide senior management with clear updates, progress and forecasts as evidenced through the company CRM
  • Nurture the customer advocacy program in support of our broader business goals
  • Prioritise activities to meet quarterly business targets while maintaining a longer-term strategic pipeline

What you’ll achieve 

You’ll be helping us achieve our mission by enabling fraud investigators across organisations to collaborate in their fight against fraud using our SaaS platform. The types of areas you’ll look at include: 
  • New Business Development
  • Leading client facing discover conversations to establish key business issues
  • Understanding and navigating the different approaches to fraud prevention across different sectors
  • Helping Clients build business cases for Smartnumbers adoption
  • Sharing intelligence and best practice across organisations
  • Increasing market awareness by supporting events, posts or other GTM activities
  • Building trust and a network of advocates among your client base

How you’ll work 

You’ll be part of an empowered cross functional go to market team that leverages best practice and seeks continual improvement. You’ll be given the freedom to manage your own time with support and guidance from senior sales leadership. You’ll be expected to build, maintain and report on a clear 12–18 month runway of pipeline with dedicated time set aside each week for strategic focus and execution on new business development.


What you'll need for the role

Smartnumbers values diversity of experience. Candidates should have a strong combination of several of the following skills, competencies and experience: 
 

  • Numbers Obsessed – You live and breathe your pipeline and progress and take pride in its resilience and accuracy.
  • Curious - You want to understand the problems our customers face and how we might solve them. You’re always looking for new opportunities to learn about our customers, the market, competitors, technology, etc.
  • Customer Focused - You start with the customer and work back whilst understanding that solutions have to work for our business
  • Outcome focused - You can define what success looks like and measure progress towards it
  • A clear communicator - You’re capable of explaining things regardless of whether it’s to a software engineer, salesperson, customer support agent or CEO


What we can offer you

As well as a competitive salary of circa £100,000 per annum, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, covering a variety of areas, both professional and personal. These benefits include:  

  • Hybrid working style, with the expectation of two days in the office (with a great City of London office base!)
  • Family friendly benefits including paid parental leave policies
  • An extensive health insurance policy for you, with an option to add your family members 
  • A workplace pension with Hargreaves Lansdown 
  • Life insurance of 4 x your salary 
  • Weekly self-development time to spend exploring your professional development interests
  • 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays), your birthday off, and an opportunity to buy up to 5 days annual leave per year
  • A holistic wellbeing support plan encompassing a variety of offerings to assist you. We provide you with a monthly £50 allowance to fund activities to best support your wellbeing as well as workshops and training to provide tools and guidance. Additionally, there is a wide-ranging employee assistance programme available to advise on personal, family or financial matters, and fun social events during the year.


The application process

We have a simple 3 stage application process: 

  1. 30-minute phone call with the hiring manager
  2. 1 hour interview and presentation
  3. HR and Bar Raiser Interview 
 
Smartnumbers is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. You will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, neurodiversity, gender, gender identity, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation. We welcome all applications for this role.  
 
We are committed to providing reasonable support/adjustments in our recruiting processes. If you need support, please reach out to the hiring contact. 
 
Please see our privacy notice: https://smartnumbers.com/privacy-notice

title: Senior Marketplace Manager

What You'll Be Doing

Client & Commercial Leadership

· You will be the senior point of contact for a portfolio of high-value brands across Amazon Vendor (1P) and Seller (3P), building trusted relationships with key stakeholders and executive sponsors.

People Leadership

· You will set the standard for team output, quality-assuring reports, recommendations and client communication before they reach the client.

· You will drive best practice, process improvements and cross-learning between Marketplace and eCommerce Acceleration teams.

· You will balance the needs of multiple clients against internal priorities, delegating effectively and managing client expectations.

Multi-Marketplace Growth & Business Contribution

· You will support brands expanding beyond Amazon UK – into pan-EU Amazon marketplaces and other channels such as Zalando, eBay, TikTok Shop and bol.

  • You will have deep, practical knowledge of both Amazon Vendor Central and Seller Central, with a proven track record of scaling brands across both models.

  • You will have a strong understanding of Amazon Advertising and how media, retail readiness and commercials combine to drive profitable growth.

  • You will have proven people management experience – developing, motivating and holding a team to a high standard.

  • You will have strong commercial acumen – comfortable with margin, profitability and setting and owning commercial targets.

  • You will have a strong analytical skill set, with advanced Excel and experience of tools such as Helium 10, Keepa or PowerBI.

  • You will have the ability to operate at a strategic level, yet remain close enough to the details to troubleshoot issues and be a real support to your team.
